# runzero_scan_template (Resource)

Manages a RunZero scan template.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acl` (Map of String) Access control list mapping organization UUIDs to permission levels.
- `global` (Boolean) Whether the template is globally available to all organizations.
- `name` (String) The name of the scan template.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID for the scan template.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the scan template.
- `grace_period` (String) Additional time beyond hard expiration deadline.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the template is hidden from common view.
- `params` (Map of String) Scan parameters for the template.
- `recur` (Boolean) Whether tasks derived from this template repeat.
- `recur_frequency` (String) Execution frequency if recurring (once, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, continuous).
- `start_time` (Number) Unix timestamp for the next execution time.

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) The explorer ID that may execute the template.
- `client_id` (String) The account ID that owns the template.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the scan template was created.
- `created_by` (String) The user who created the template.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the scan template.
- `linked_task_count` (Number) Number of tasks derived from the template.
- `recur_last` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last recurring execution.
- `recur_next` (Number) Unix timestamp of the next recurring execution.
- `site_id` (String) The site ID for the template.
- `status` (String) The status of the last task using the template.
- `type` (String) The type of task the template creates.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the scan template was last updated.
